title: What You Carry
hook: The crash is behind you. Check the kit.
scene: Rain still, same viaduct, you already gave the gap. The two cars are behind you. You are on a legal pad at the next ramp. Radios are trash. A passerby who is already clear does not get a speech. Triangles, first aid, a paper list of numbers, water — that is the kit. Walking back onto the viaduct with nothing is how a witness becomes a body. Check what you carry before you roll.
decision: You are on a pad after a crash that was not yours. What do you do now?

options.text: Walk back onto the viaduct with nothing and try to help from the travel lane
options.result: You leave a Beetle on a pad and become a body in a live lane. The next car does not expect you. Helping from the travel path is how a witness writes a third crash. The kit stayed in the trunk.

options.text: Call and spend it on whose fault it was, then invent a count you did not write down
options.result: You get someone on the line and spend it on a verdict. They still do not have a mile marker. A passerby does not get that script. You burned a call the book never gave you.

options.text: Post the crash to the convoy board so someone closer can deal with the kit
options.result: The board just passes talk. Nobody has triangles on this ramp. You handed a crash to a chorus and left your own kit shut. The pad stays a rumor.

options.text: Confirm the kit — triangles, first aid, paper numbers, water — then roll when the pad is clear
options.result: You open the kit. Triangles. First aid. A paper list of numbers. Water. You do not walk back onto the viaduct. You do not invent a call script. When the pad is clear you roll. That is what you carry.

debrief: A passerby does not get a 911 script. Keep an emergency kit: triangles, first aid, paper numbers, water. You saved a walk back onto the viaduct.

source.psdp_skill: Skill ten: city driving – part two
source.teaching_target: Emergency kit (5.9): triangles, first aid, paper numbers, water. Replaced the witness 911 script — Witnessing a crash has no passerby call script (do not block, do not stare).
